title: Build: a rational number in lowest terms

checklist.step: Keep the ratio, reduce it, and put the sign on the numerator
Show every Euclid step, then the stored fraction

hints: A constructor may store different numbers from the ones it was given, as long as they stand for the same ratio.
Reducing and choosing where the sign goes are two separate promises. Try 8/-12 and 0/-7 by hand.
Divide both parts by the gcd. If the denominator you were given is negative, divide by minus the gcd instead: that reduces and flips both signs in one step.
